notes.title: DLC eBooklet Updated!
notes.content:
The DLC eBooklet now includes an achievement guide! If the eBooklet did not install on your desktop, you can find it using the following steps:
[olist]
[*]Right-clicking the Captive in your library->properties
[*]Installed Files tab->Browse
[*]Look for Captive You Are My Idol - Development Journal
[/olist]
